stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena is grouping the plants growing in her school garden in Jaipur. Which of the following groupings uses a valid basis ( )
A. Rose and tulsi are grouped together because their names have the same number of letters
B. Mango and neem are grouped together because both are believed to bring good luck
C. Hibiscus and sunflower are grouped together because both plants bear flowers
D. Coconut and cactus are grouped together because both are tall plants

options.text: Rose and tulsi are grouped together because their names have the same number of letters
Mango and neem are grouped together because both are believed to bring good luck
Hibiscus and sunflower are grouped together because both plants bear flowers
Coconut and cactus are grouped together because both are tall plants

teacher.key_rationale: Only option C groups plants using a shared observable feature (both bear flowers), which is a valid basis for grouping based on similarities and differences. A uses spelling of names (a surface feature, not a plant characteristic), B uses a belief about luck rather than an observable feature, and D is factually shaky as a grouping basis since height is not a common distinguishing feature shared meaningfully by coconut and cactus and is not applied consistently.
